question: Between the tallest and shortest players, who has the higher average finishing attribute across his recorded assessments? Give the player's name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.height IN ((SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player), (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)) GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name ORDER BY AVG(a.finishing) DESC, p.player_api_id LIMIT 1
